answer: Bridge independent attestations before granting market access: an agent earns trading rights only when verifiers from three unrelated domains, a payment rail, a compute provider, a reputation registry, each sign a bridge certificate for the same identity. Reaching that zenith is routine for a real agent, whose voyage already spans all three domains, but a Sybil farmer must forge or buy three independent endorsements per fake. Each forgery costs money and leaves a cross-checkable trail, and one failed certificate voids the set, so a thousand fakes cost roughly a thousand times one.
